Before calculating, note that Meta reports "revenue" while Amazon reports "net sales" — both represent top-line revenue and are conceptually comparable for growth-rate purposes, though the underlying business models (advertising vs. e-commerce/cloud) differ substantially in scale and composition [DOC-1].

**Meta Platforms revenue growth (FY2023 → FY2024):**
Revenue rose from $134,902M to $164,501M [DOC-1].
Growth = (164,501 − 134,902) / 134,902 = 29,599 / 134,902 ≈ 21.94%

**Amazon.com net sales growth (FY2023 → FY2024):**
Net sales rose from $574,785M to $637,959M [DOC-1].
Growth = (637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 = 63,174 / 574,785 ≈ 10.99%

**Comparison:**
Meta's revenue grew faster than Amazon's net sales over this period, by approximately 21.94% − 10.99% ≈ 10.95 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (Meta ~21.94% vs. Amazon ~10.99%)
